curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can Batman track down his nemesis before the Joker's twisted experiment on the Gordon family proves his point about human sanity?
curatedMovie.description: While Batman pursues an escaped Joker, the Clown Prince of Crime targets the Gordon family in a calculated assault designed to mirror his own descent into madness.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, dark, and emotionally intense. A gritty psychological clash best suited for focused solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Sam Liu delivers a brisk, heavy animated crime thriller that pushes the legendary psychological duel between Batman and the Joker to grim extremes.
